scientific_integrity: The proof is a self-contained form comparison and variational limit, with the published weighted-shift family and numerical-radius antecedents credited. The finite exact-arithmetic checker verifies critical identities but does not certify the infinite-dimensional limit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for fixed positive s and t, supplies only the sharp leading-order q-to-one asymptotic, and has no uniform remainder as s or t degenerates.
title: A sharp Airy-edge law for four-periodic geometric weighted shifts
